bodyHtml:
📷 Photos, Documents & VHS · Logan & Surrounds

Photo & Document Organisation Logan. Decades Of Memories, Finally Sorted.

Thousands of photos scattered across old phones, memory cards and a shoebox of prints. A cupboard of ageing VHS tapes and slide carousels nobody has a player for anymore. Computer Repairs Logan helps you declutter, organise and digitise it all, so it's safe, searchable, and actually enjoyed again instead of gathering dust.

Organise My Photos
✓ Photo & Document Sorting
✓ Duplicate Removal
✓ VHS & Slide Digitisation
✓ Cloud & Local Backup
Why It Matters

Unorganised Photos Are Photos You'll Eventually Lose.

Duplicate copies scattered across old phones and cloud accounts, folders with no structure, and physical photos, tapes and slides slowly degrading in a cupboard, none of it is actually backed up until it's in one organised, protected place.

Our Approach

Sort It, Digitise It, Back It Up.

We consolidate photos from every device and account, remove duplicates, organise everything into a sensible folder structure, digitise physical media, and set up an ongoing backup so it's protected going forward.

What's Included

What's Included In Our Photo & Document Organisation Service.

📥

Consolidation

Pulling photos and documents together from old phones, cameras, memory cards, laptops and multiple cloud accounts into one place.

🗂️

Sorting & De-duplication

Removing duplicate and near-duplicate photos, and organising what's left into a clear folder structure by date or event.

📼

VHS Tape Digitisation

Converting home videos on VHS, Video8 and MiniDV tapes into digital video files before the tapes degrade further.

🖼️

Slide & Print Scanning

Scanning old photo prints and 35mm slide carousels into high-resolution digital images.

📄

Document Organisation

Sorting and digitising important paper documents so they're searchable and no longer at risk from fire, flood or simply getting lost.

☁️

Backup & Sharing Setup

Getting your organised photo and document library backed up properly, and set up so family members can access or contribute to it.

Who It's For

A Common Job For A Good Reason.

  • Downsizing or moving house. Digitising boxes of photos, slides and tapes before they're thrown out or lost in the move.
  • Passed-down family archives. Inherited photo albums, slide carousels and home videos that need preserving before the media degrades further.
  • Years of unsorted phone photos. Thousands of images with no structure, full of duplicates and screenshots.
  • Getting organised before a big backup. Decluttering first so you're not paying to back up duplicates and clutter.
Organise My Photos
Related Services

Protect What We Organise.

Once your photo and document library is sorted, keep it safe with an ongoing cloud backup or store it locally on a home NAS the whole family can access. Already lost photos to a failed drive or accidental deletion? Our data recovery service may still be able to bring them back. And if you just need everything moved cleanly onto a new computer, see our data backup and transfer service.

Frequently Asked Questions

Photo & Document Organisation Questions, Answered.

Can you digitise old VHS tapes and slides?

Yes, we convert VHS, Video8 and MiniDV home videos into digital files, and scan 35mm slides and photo prints into high-resolution images, so they're preserved before the physical media degrades any further.

How do you deal with duplicate photos?

We consolidate photos from all your devices and accounts, then identify and remove duplicate and near-duplicate images so what's left is a clean, organised library rather than thousands of repeated shots.

Will my photos be organised in a way I can actually find things?

Yes, we typically organise by date and event into a clear folder structure, so you can browse or search for a specific occasion rather than scrolling through an unsorted camera roll.

Do you back up the photos once they're organised?

We recommend it, an organised library is only truly safe once it's backed up. We can set up cloud backup, local NAS storage, or both, as part of the same job.

How much does photo and document organisation cost?

It depends on the volume of photos and documents, how much physical media needs digitising, and how it's currently organised. Get in touch and we'll give you a straight quote over the phone.

Ready To Finally Sort Those Photos?

From a shoebox of prints to years of unsorted phone photos, we'll get it organised, digitised and backed up.

Organise My Photos
